tasks.gr8-climate-regions-in-south-africa-and-: Topic: Climate regions in South Africa and the world. Cover climate controls (latitude, altitude, ocean currents, and relief), world climate regions, South African climate patterns, and climate graphs. Ask Grade 8 learners to compare regional climates, interpret graph evidence, and explain why temperature and rainfall differ between places.
tasks.gr8-climate-factors-and-sa-climate-t2: Topic: Factors that influence temperature and rainfall, and South Africa's climate. Cover latitude, distance from the sea, altitude (about 6,5 degrees cooler per 1 000 m), ocean currents (Agulhas and Benguela) and relief (rain shadow), and use them to explain the climate of selected places such as Cape Town, Durban, Johannesburg, Port Nolloth, Upington and George. Keep figures qualitative unless they come from a stated source.
tasks.gr8-climate-kinds-and-climate-graphs-t2: Topic: Climate around the world. Cover weather and climate, the elements of weather, the ten kinds of climate (tropical, subtropical, temperate, desert, semi-desert, continental, polar, Mediterranean, tundra, alpine), reading climate graphs (bars for rainfall, a line for temperature) and where each kind occurs. Ask Grade 8 learners to describe a climate from a graph.
